field_classification_schema.STABLE_REFERENCE: Structural identifier — facility name, district assignment, facility type, static coordinates. Changes only via government reorganisation. Safe to bundle.
field_classification_schema.MUTABLE_CONTACT: Phone numbers, fax, email, operating hours. Subject to change without formal gazette notification. Must display stale label after freshness window.
field_classification_schema.REALTIME_OR_UNKNOWN: Bed availability, waiting time, on-call roster, emergency alert status. Always NETWORK_REQUIRED. Never bundle.

hard_invariants: 24_hour field: MUST remain null when source does not explicitly state 24-hour operation. Never infer false from absence.
Emergency dispatch numbers (112, 108, 100) may be bundled as well-known STABLE_REFERENCE constants.
Bed availability is ALWAYS REALTIME_OR_UNKNOWN — never bundle.
Phone numbers require freshness label in UI after 90-day cache window.
null_inference_rule: If a field is absent from the source record, the mobile client MUST display null / unknown — never infer a value. Applies especially to: operating_hours, emergency_availability, 24_hour.
